newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK NOV INFLATION DROPS BELOW 8.0PCT - SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK NOV INFLATION DROPS BELOW 8.0PCT - SOURCE.

text.p: Greece's consumer price inflation will definitely be below 8.0 percent year-on-year in November, perhaps lower than 7.9 percent, from 8.3 percent in October, a government source told Reuters.
"Inflation is definitely below 8.0 percent in November and might not even stop at 7.9 percent," the source told Reuters.
Press reports have said CPI inflation would be between 7.9 and 8.0 percent in November.
Core inflation stood at 8.0 percent year-on-year in October, down from 8.2 percent in September. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
